newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-JOPPY STOPS MCELROY TO RETAIN WBA MIDDLEWEIGHT CROWN. [corrected 09:20 gmt 20/10]
newsitem.headline: BOXING-JOPPY STOPS MCELROY TO RETAIN WBA MIDDLEWEIGHT CROWN. [corrected 09:20 gmt 20/10]

text.p: World Boxing Association middleweight champion William Joppy retained his crown Saturday by stopping fellow-American Ray Charles McElroy at 1:41 of the sixth round (corrects round) of their scheduled 12-rounder.
Joppy improved his unbeaten record to 23-0-1. McElroy dropped to 21-5.
